summary: Final report BW21_0453 for Avernelwick Pharmaceuticals Ltd: hERG automated patch clamp, 5-isoform CYP panel, 3A4 concentration response on 42 compounds (Aminopyrimidine regioisomer). Study summary table on page 1; full compound tables, methods, controls and deviations follow.

title_block.title: AP02 second-generation safety panel with CYP3A4 concentration response
title_block.subtitle: Final Report
lines: Study lead: Dr L. Benmezroun, Study Director

blocks.p: 42 compounds from the Avernelwick aminopyrimidine regioisomer series 02 were tested for Avernelwick Pharmaceuticals Ltd in the hERG automated patch clamp, 5-isoform CYP panel, 3A4 concentration response. Testing started on 08 November 2021 and results were reported on 25 November 2021. All accepted runs met plate acceptance criteria; one run was rejected and repeated (see Section 6). No compound had a hERG IC50 below 1 µM. The set divided almost evenly around 10 µM (20 below, 22 at or above 10 µM or above the top concentration). Inhibition above 50% at 10 µM was most frequent for CYP3A4; CYP1A2 was rarely affected.
To rank the screening set for hERG automated patch clamp, 5-isoform CYP panel, 3A4 concentration response liability so that Avernelwick Pharmaceuticals Ltd could choose analogues for progression.

42 compounds were received as 10 mM DMSO solutions in one test lot on 08 November 2021 and logged against B-ACC-2021-07710. Identity and concentration were taken as supplied by the client. Stocks were stored at -20 °C and thawed once for testing.

HEK293 cells stably expressing hERG (Kv11.1) were recorded in whole-cell configuration on a 16-channel automated patch clamp platform at room temperature. Cells are held at -80 mV, depolarised to +40 mV for 2 s and repolarised to -50 mV for 2 s to elicit the tail current, at 0.1 Hz. Each compound was applied cumulatively at 0.12, 0.37, 1.1, 3.3, 10 and 30 µM (0.3% DMSO final). Each concentration is held until the tail-current block reaches a steady state (change below 5% over the last three sweeps), with a minimum of 3 and a maximum of 8 minutes; compounds still drifting at 8 minutes are flagged as slow-onset.
E-4031 is run as a separate 6-point concentration response (1-300 nM) on every run.

list: Plate acceptance: seal resistance ≥500 MΩ before break-in and ≥200 MΩ throughout
Tail current ≥200 pA at baseline; run-down ≤10% over the vehicle period
E-4031 IC50 within 5-50 nM; runs outside this range are rejected and repeated
IC50 fitted per cell (four-parameter logistic); the compound IC50 is the geometric mean of finite cell IC50s when these are the majority of accepted cells, otherwise reported as >30 µM
Where precipitation is seen at 30 µM, that concentration is excluded and the highest evaluable concentration is reported

blocks.p: Pooled human liver microsomes (0.1 mg/mL protein) were incubated with each compound at 10 µM and an isoform-selective probe substrate at approximately Km, in duplicate, for 10 minutes at 37 °C after NADPH addition. Metabolite formation is measured by LC-MS/MS against vehicle (0.1% DMSO) incubations; the lower limit of quantitation of each metabolite is at least 20-fold below the vehicle signal.

Positive controls are run as 7-point concentration responses on every run. Furafylline and ticlopidine (mechanism-based inhibitors) are preincubated with microsomes and NADPH for 15 minutes before probe addition. A run is accepted when each control IC50 falls within 0.5-2 times the laboratory historical mean. Results are reported as mean percent inhibition relative to vehicle; values above 50% at 10 µM are flagged, and small negative values indicate no inhibition.

All compounds were run in a 7-point CYP3A4 concentration response (top concentration 50 µM, 3-fold dilutions) using midazolam 1'-hydroxylation as the probe, with ketoconazole on every plate. A single probe is used so that IC50s are comparable across the set; substrate-dependent differences are outside the scope.

All {{PRJ0002:herg.n_tested}} compounds were tested. No compound had a hERG IC50 below 1 µM. The set divided almost evenly around 10 µM (20 below, 22 at or above 10 µM or above the top concentration). The median IC50 was {{PRJ0002:herg.median_ic50_uM}} µM ({{PRJ0002:herg.n_lt_1uM}} below 1 µM, {{PRJ0002:herg.n_1_10uM}} between 1 and 10 µM, {{PRJ0002:herg.n_ge_10uM}} at or above 10 µM, of which {{PRJ0002:herg.n_censored}} above the highest evaluable concentration). E-4031 gave an IC50 of {{PRJ0002:herg.control_e4031_nM}} nM in the accepted runs.
Compounds with QC notes: AP02-01586: First run rejected (E-4031 outside range); repeated. Values for these compounds should be read with the note.

Inhibition above 50% at 10 µM was most frequent for CYP3A4; CYP1A2 was rarely affected. In total {{PRJ0002:cyp.n_any_gt50}} compounds inhibited at least one isoform by more than 50% at 10 µM (CYP3A4: {{PRJ0002:cyp.n_gt50_CYP3A4}}; CYP2D6: {{PRJ0002:cyp.n_gt50_CYP2D6}}; CYP2C19: {{PRJ0002:cyp.n_gt50_CYP2C19}}; CYP2C9: {{PRJ0002:cyp.n_gt50_CYP2C9}}; CYP1A2: {{PRJ0002:cyp.n_gt50_CYP1A2}}). All control IC50s were within 0.5-2 times the historical mean (ketoconazole {{PRJ0002:cyp.control_CYP3A4_uM}} µM against a historical mean of {{PRJ0002:cyp.hist_CYP3A4_uM}} µM).

CYP3A4 IC50s were determined for all {{PRJ0002:cyp3a4_ic50.n_tested}} compounds: {{PRJ0002:cyp3a4_ic50.n_lt_10uM}} had IC50 below 10 µM, including {{PRJ0002:cyp3a4_ic50.n_lt_1uM}} below 1 µM. These potent inhibitors are the main CYP liability in the set.
The first hERG run for one compound was rejected because E-4031 fell outside its acceptance range; the compound was retested in a later run and only accepted data are reported.

No compound had a hERG IC50 below 1 µM. The set divided almost evenly around 10 µM (20 below, 22 at or above 10 µM or above the top concentration). Inhibition above 50% at 10 µM was most frequent for CYP3A4; CYP1A2 was rarely affected. These are screening data; mechanism statements are outside the scope of this study.

Recommended next steps: prioritise compounds with hERG IC50 at or above 10 µM; for any compound below 10 µM, compare the IC50 with projected free plasma exposure before progression; repeat the flagged hERG measurements if a selection decision depends on them; deprioritise compounds with CYP3A4 IC50 below 1 µM and review the below-10 µM group with the chemistry team.
Raw data, run sheets and instrument files are retained for 5 years under B-ACC-2021-07710.
